scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix packages/backend" "npm run dev --prefix packages/frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix packages/backend && npm install --prefix packages/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/backend && npm run build --prefix packages/frontend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix packages/backend && npm run type-check --prefix packages/frontend
